analysis.summary: Senco Gold reported a strong financial year for FY26 driven by revenue growth, expansion, and customer trust despite high gold price volatility. Management guided for an 18% to 20% revenue growth for the full year alongside a sustainable EBITDA margin of 7.5% to 7.8% and PAT margin between 4% and 4.5%. The company plans to open 18 to 20 stores with a focus on franchise expansion in smaller towns and tier 2, 3, and 4 cities. Furthermore, management highlighted increased traction in old gold exchange programmes and lightweight jewellery to maintain affordability and sustain consumer demand. Senco Gold reported strong financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, achieving record standalone and consolidated revenue of Rs 8,430 Cr with 33% YoY growth.

guidance.claim: Management plans to open 18 to 20 stores.
guidance.quote: 18 to 20 stores is what we would like to open.

guidance.claim: Management targets FY27 value growth of 20%+ and EBITDA margins ranging from 7.5% to 7.7%.
guidance.quote: We are confidently marching toward FY27 targets of 20%+ value growth while targeting EBITDA margins in the range of 7.5%–7.7%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q4 revenue growth of 25% plus.
guidance.quote: This particular quarter, we hope that we will be 25% plus growth that will continue to happen.

guidance.claim: Management targets a revenue growth of 20% plus for the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: and have a growth of 20% plus for the coming financial year as well.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a sustainable full-year EBITDA margin of around 7.5% to 7.8% for FY27.
guidance.quote: recently in this quarter, we have given guidance of around 7.5% to 7.8% for FY '27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumers have taken the Prime Minister's announcement seriously and are adopting a wait-and-watch approach.
demand_outlook.quote: So, see, it's been about 7 to 10 days, and consumers have taken our Honourable Prime Minister's announcement seriously, and they are actually looking at a more wait-and-watch situation.

demand_outlook.claim: The ongoing Adhik Maas is noted as an inauspicious time to buy gold which could cause a current slowdown.
demand_outlook.quote: And along with that, the Adhik Maas, an inauspicious time to buy, also started.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that May performance year-to-date remains broadly similar to the corresponding period last year.
demand_outlook.quote: So, all in all, YTD, you will still see growth. But in the last 7 to 10 days, the footfalls at the stores have come down.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed that average ticket size has grown by almost 30% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: So, our ATV, if you look at it, our average ticket size has grown by almost 30%YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer demand remained resilient in value supported by a well-distributed wedding season and growing preference for lightweight jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite this, consumer demand remained resilient in value, driven by a well-distributed wedding season spanning the full quarter. There has been a gradual shift towards lightweight jewelleryorlowercaratage.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed ~50% to Q4 revenue, enabling customers to upgrade jewellery despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Growth was driven by a well-distributed wedding season spanning the full quarter, strong gifting demand on Valentine’s Day, and continued leveraging of Old Gold Exchange programme, which contributed ~ 50% to Q4 revenue, enabling customers to upgrade jewellery despite elevated gold prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer prioritisation of long-term value caused silver volumes to surge by ~35% YoY in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver volumes surged by ~35% YoY in FY26 as consumers prioritised long-term value.

demand_outlook.claim: Diamond volumes grew by ~9% YoY in FY26, indicating strong demand for natural diamonds as a first choice.
demand_outlook.quote: Similarly, diamond volumes alsogrew ~9%YoYinFY26,clearly indicating demand for natural diamonds asa first choice.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumers are preponing purchases due to wedding requirements despite volatile gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: The wedding season also continues to remain strong, and we are seeing that many consumers are not only having weddings in the close proximity, but also in maybe 6 months, 8 months down the line. But in these volatile gold prices, they are thinking that these could be the good levels to buy, and they are preponing their purchases and buying.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the growth in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets has been robust.
demand_outlook.quote: We have also seen that the growth in the Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets has been robust as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that volume decreased by 3% for the quarter and 10% for the 9-month period for gold.
demand_outlook.quote: So the volume -- as I mentioned, the volume degrowth in quarter 3 was minus 3% like quarter-on-quarter. And for the whole 9 months, if you look at it, it is minus 10%. That is for gold.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that diamond volumes grew by 12.5% for the 9-month period.
demand_outlook.quote: And for diamonds, if you look at just diamonds as a product, then it is up by 12.5% for the 9 months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that old gold exchange has increased from 25% to 30% historically to 45% to 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: So when the old gold exchange comes in, then automatically those price risks that we always talk about is partially reduced. And keeping all those aspects in mind, we've also started to focus on the customer advances with gold rate getting fixed. That itself also starts working as a hedging tool.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 12 exclusive Sennes stores.
Senco expanded its showroom network to 201 showrooms globally by launching 26 showrooms during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Showroom network expands to 201 showrooms (COCO- 102, FRN- 85, Sennes- 12 and Dubai- 2). We launched 26 showrooms (COCO- 6, FRN- 14 and Sennes- 6) in FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: In Q4 FY26, the company launched 7 new showrooms across franchisee, company-owned, and Sennes formats.
capex_expansion.quote: InQ4 FY26, we launched 7 new showrooms (Franchisee- 2, Company owned- 1 and Sennes- 4).

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the current store network stands at 196 stores and expects to reach 200 plus stores by the end of the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, we have 196 stores in the whole network. And hopefully, by the end of this quarter, we should be reaching 200 plus stores as we end this particular quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Management guided for opening 18 to 20 stores next year with a mix of own and franchisee stores.
capex_expansion.quote: Next year, sir, we continue to focus on 18 to 20 stores. Our focus will be on opening more franchisee stores, broadly 8 to 10 own stores, 8 to 10 franchisees.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross margin and EBITDA were higher than previous guidance due to gold and silver price rises and product mix improvements.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, gross margin and EBITDA were higher than our earlier guidance of 7.5% to 7.8% for the quarter as well as for the whole year, as we have explained earlier that this is due to the price rise in gold and silver and a part of it is due to the improvement in the product mix, premiumization, our movement to North outside Bengal, where our ASP ratings are very high.

margins_costs.claim: Management guided that inventory days have increased to 186 days.
margins_costs.quote: Inventory days have increased to 186 days.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains a hedging ratio of about 40% to 50% to balance risks.
margins_costs.quote: We've kept a steady mind and a steady head and kept our hedging ratio at about 40% to 50% to balance between all kinds of risk.

margins_costs.claim: Sennes business as a whole is EBITDA positive in its second year.
margins_costs.quote: And within the second year itself, Sennes' business as a whole is EBITDA positive.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin and EBITDA for Q4 FY26 exceeded the guidance range of 7.5-7.7% due to gold and silver price rise gains.
Management reported an adjusted EBITDA margin of around 13.2% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the adjusted EBITDA margin is around 13.2%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted a one-time extraordinary impact of around INR6.2 crores due to the labour code.
margins_costs.quote: Moreover, as far as the labour code is concerned, we have analysed the impact of the labour code, and we have taken a one-time extraordinary impact of around INR6.2 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross margins at steady gold prices are between 15% and 16%.
margins_costs.quote: 15% to 16%, sir. You can take 15.5% to 16% or you can take 15% to 15.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management proposed a final dividend of 20% in addition to the earlier interim dividend of 15%.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also extremely happy to discuss with the Board and propose a final dividend of 20% in addition to the earlier interim dividend of 15% that we had announced.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that working capital requirements increased with inventory value rising from INR2,963 crores to INR4,602 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, this is on the financial side. The working capital requirement has also increased. So, what you have seen is that the inventory value has increased from INR2,963 crores to INR4,602 crores. This has been funded by the borrowing as well as the trade payable.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that working capital limits are at INR2,400 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital limit, which is INR2,400 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gold and silver prices were extremely volatile during Q4.
risks_headwinds.quote: From a macro standpoint, if you've seen that, especially in Q4, the gold price and the silver price have been extremely volatile.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the recent heat wave has significantly impacted footfalls during daytime.
risks_headwinds.quote: We could also see the heat wave having a great impact, in which the consumers are not getting much out of the house, and only in the evening, they are out.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that total inventory increased 61% year-on-year to INR 5,296 crores due to higher gold prices, showroom launches, and logistics preparation.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the working capital front, our total inventory increased 61% Y-o-Y to INR5,296 crores. There are 2-3 reasons for this. One is that the gold price increased, and due to that, the GML and all those things increased. Similarly, there was an increase in inventory for the 7 new showrooms launched. Then we increased the inventory at the existing stores, but most of it was in value terms, not in volume terms.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management maintains around 40-50% hedging to mitigate price and liquidity risks in uncertain markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: We have maintained around 40-50% hedging to manage price volatility risk and liquidity risk in uncertain markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: The exceptional rise in gold prices by 79% YoY and 20% QoQ negatively impacted volume growth, causing a normalised ~6% YoY reduction in gold volumes for FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: Average gold prices surged by 79% YoY and 20% QoQ, peaking at a historic high of Rs 1,69,403/10gm, impacting volume growth. This exceptional price rise led to a normalised ~6% YoY reduction in gold volumes in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the financial year has been extremely volatile with gold prices reaching INR1,40,000 for the quarter and going further up.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this is something which becomes much more special because we have seen that this particular financial year has been one that has been extremely volatile. The gold prices have reached INR1,40,000 for that particular quarter. Post that, it has gone up further.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to open 18 to 20 stores.
management_commitments.quote: 18 to 20 stores is what we would like to open.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that old gold exchange is targeted at a minimum of 50% of the overall business.
management_commitments.quote: I think that old gold exchange is a minimum 50% of the overall business to move ahead from that, what we are seeing should be something that should be a benchmark, and we should work towards getting it.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to increase the factory manufacturing share to 10%.
management_commitments.quote: We want to take the factory manufacturing to 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to increase the GML portion to 50% plus.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we intend to increase the GML portion to 50% plus.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets FY27 value growth of 20%+ alongside EBITDA margins between 7.5% and 7.7%.
management_commitments.quote: We are confidently marching toward FY27 targets of 20%+ value growth while targeting EBITDA margins in the range of 7.5%–7.7%.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to grow revenue by 20% plus for the coming financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and have a growth of 20% plus for the coming financial year as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets sustainable full-year EBITDA margins of 7.5% to 7.8% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: recently in this quarter, we have given guidance of around 7.5% to 7.8% for FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to open 18 to 20 stores in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Next year, sir, we continue to focus on 18 to 20 stores. Our focus will be on opening more franchisee stores, broadly 8 to 10 own stores, 8 to 10 franchisees.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to submit ROCE details by August to enhance the customer advance limit.
management_commitments.quote: Once we file the return for this purpose, including the ROCE details—which we plan to submit by August—the limit will be enhanced to ₹500 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
